title: Transport of a base-change mate along the source and apex
statement:
theorem derivedBaseChange_source_transport
    [∀ X : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    {Y Y' B A P P' : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ B) (j : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (r : P ⟶ Y) (s : P ⟶ A) (r' : P' ⟶ Y') (s' : P' ⟶ A) (k : P' ⟶ P)
    (h : r ≫ p = s ≫ g) (h' : r' ≫ (j ≫ p) = s' ≫ g)
    (hr : k ≫ r = r' ≫ j) (hs : k ≫ s = s')
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory Y')
    (T : schemeDerivedCategory P) (T' : schemeDerivedCategory P')
    (a : (derivedPullback j).obj K ⟶ K')
    (q : (derivedPullback r).obj K ⟶ T)
    (q' : (derivedPullback r').obj K' ⟶ T')
    (d : (derivedPullback k).obj T ⟶ T')
    (hq : (derivedPullback k).map q ≫ d =
      (relativeMVComp k r).hom.app K ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ (derivedPullback f).obj K) hr) ≫
        (relativeMVComp r' j).inv.app K ≫ (derivedPullback r').map a ≫ q') :
    let e := (schemeDerivedDirectImage p).map ((relativeMVAdj j).unit.app K) ≫
      (relativeMVImageComp j p).hom.app ((derivedPullback j).obj K) ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (j ≫ p)).map a
    let F := (schemeDerivedDirectImage s).map ((relativeMVAdj k).unit.app T) ≫
      (relativeMVImageComp k s).hom.app ((derivedPullback k).obj T) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj
        ((derivedPullback k).obj T)) hs) ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage s').map d
    schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap p s g r h K ≫ (schemeDerivedDirectImage s).map q ≫ F =
      (derivedPullback g).map e ≫ schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (j ≫ p) s' g r' h' K' ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage s').map q'

source.place: Tags 06YJ, 08HY and 0D5S; source coefficient and mate calculations of lem-pc-standard-single-base-change-top-restriction-compatibility

proof.text: Eliminate hs, define c from the two pullback composition comparisons and hr, and put q0 = c.inv followed by Lk(q). The elementary adjunction mate-unit identity turns Lr(unit_j), the inner base-change mate and Rk(q0) into q followed by unit_k. Cancel c.inv against the coefficient hypothesis to obtain q0;d = Lr'(a);q'. Coefficient naturality is proved locally from adjunction Hom-equivalence naturality, comparison naturality and counit naturality; the existing Naturality module cannot be imported because its source import closure reaches the item.

Apply coefficient naturality to unit_j in the outer square, then horizontal mate pasting to j,p and k,s. Move q0 through the image-composition comparison by naturality and cancel its inverse. Substitute q0;d, apply coefficient naturality to a, and reassociate the functor maps. This proves the displayed source/apex transport identity without any isomorphism hypothesis.
